releaseNotes: Preserves the existing Firebase login/account flow and does not add a Cloudflare dependency.
Fixes completed Practice Mode reports so Close report returns to Dialogue Practice instead of Home, while Mock Test reports return to Mock Test.
Adds a searchable Content Studio that can find dialogues by ID, title, topic, English text or Hindi text.
Adds a Dialogue Learning Hub before Learning Mode with Learn Vocabs and Start Dialogue choices.
Adds 105 dialogue-specific key-vocabulary sets containing 1,649 reviewed English-Hindi terms selected from the dialogue title and meaning of all segments.
Uses the existing vocabulary player for dialogue vocabulary and adds Back to Dialogue only when that player was opened from a dialogue.
Saves partial dialogue-vocabulary progress and resumes the student near the last practised term.
Keeps dialogue-vocabulary progress separate from Core Vocabulary and Phrase progress, and includes it in backup/restore and Firebase sync.
Keeps V14 natural-Hindi dialogue content and the preferred चिकित्सक terminology unchanged.
